subject: Marketplace pricing escalation: Fulcrum Analytics private offer request
messages:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@fulcrum.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@fulcrum.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AWS private offer + marketplace listing discount

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput numbers were very compelling. We're preparing an AWS Marketplace listing and want to present a private offer for our initial pilot (12 months, committed). Procurement asked me to confirm if Redwood can provide a marketplace private offer at 30% off list for the first-year seats and waive integration fees. They also want marketplace listing terms aligned with a reseller/co-sell motion with AWS.

High-level:
- Region: US-first (we may expand to EU later)
- Expected ARR on contract year 1: ~$420k
- Primary ask: 30% discount on marketplace price for private offer + $0 integration fee
- Timeline: Need approval for the private offer by EOD Aug 5 to meet AWS marketplace publishing window

Can you escalate to deal desk? If you need a forecast or a simple purchase order, I can loop in our procurement lead (procurement@fulcrum.ai).

Thanks,
Ava Collins
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Fulcrum Analytics
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sales_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: AWS private offer + marketplace listing discount

Laura / Marissa — forwarding Fulcrum's request. They are asking for a 30% private-offer discount for year 1 and to waive integration fees. Deal is mid-market ($420k ARR first year). They want approval by EOD Wed Aug 5 to hit AWS publishing deadlines.

Notes:
- Fulcrum has existing traction (referenced in our CE notes) and is an AWS ISV partner (co-sell could be attractive).
- We usually cap marketplace private-offer discounts at 25% for this tier, and we have standard integration credits rather than full waivers.

Please advise whether we can make a one-time exception (30% + waive fees) with an MCC or if we need to propose an alternate structure: 25% + $25k integration credit + co-sell commitment from Fulcrum.

Attachments: Fulcrum_Prices_Workbook.xlsx (pricing build), Fulcrum_SOW_v3.pdf

-JW
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: AWS private offer + marketplace listing discount

Jonas — quick thoughts from prosecution and pricing:

1) Discount guardrails: for committed ARR >= $400k we can consider up to 30% but require a 12-month non-cancellable term and an uplift on committed seats if usage exceeds X TPM (we'll negotiate exact metric).
2) Integration fees: waiving entirely sets a precedent. Recommend offering a $20k integration credit applied as a usage rebate on the marketplace invoice (keeps bookkeeping cleaner for Marketplace).
3) Co-sell ask: require a minimal joint marketing commitment (1 co-branded webinar + AWS co-sell MQL target) to qualify for headline discount.
4) Approval path: I can approve this as a one-off conditional approval if Sales Ops documents the private-offer terms in HubSpot and we include a fallback to 25% if co-sell commitments aren't met by month 3.

If everyone agrees, I'll sign off and ask Finance to prepare the private-offer bundle for AWS. Timebox: need final wording by Aug 5 COB.

-Laura
VP, Revenue Operations
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@redwood.ai, aws-partner@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: AWS private offer + marketplace listing discount

Thanks Laura — I agree with the conditional path. A few practical items for the note to Finance / Deal Desk: 

- Proposed private-offer components: 30% off list for year 1 (conditional), $20k integration credit (marketplace rebate line item), 12-month minimum term, co-sell commit (1 webinar + joint account exec briefing), clause to revert to 25% if co-sell KPIs not met by day 90.
- Need to capture this in HubSpot under Deal RDW-2026-0421 and attach the Fulcrum workbook.
- Ask AWS Partner team to stamp support for the private offer (cc'd aws-partner). Their backing will smooth publishing and co-sell assignment.

I'll prepare the private-offer template and a short summary to send to Finance/Deal Desk. Can Jonas please confirm Fulcrum's PO timeline and whether they will accept the co-sell clause?

-M
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@fulcrum.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aws-partner@redwood.ai, procurement@fulcrum.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: AWS private offer + marketplace listing discount

Ava — thanks for the quick turn. We discussed internally and can approve a conditional private offer to meet your timeline. Summary below (will be issued as the official private-offer bundle once Finance finalizes):

- Year 1 list discount: 30% (conditional)
- Integration: $20,000 marketplace rebate applied on first invoice
- Term: 12-month minimum non-cancellable term
- Co-sell / marketing: 1 co-branded webinar within 90 days + joint account executive briefing cadence; if co-sell KPIs (attendance and AWS MQL threshold) are not met by day 90, the private offer discount reverts to 25% retention for remaining term.
- Deliverables: Fulcrum must sign PO by Aug 12 and confirm joint webinar date within 30 days of contract signature.

We will route the private-offer through Finance and AWS marketplace team for publication. I copied the AWS partner team to confirm co-sell assignment on their side. We'll upload the finalized private-offer doc to HubSpot and send you the DocuSign link.

Attachments: Fulcrum_Prices_Workbook.xlsx; Fulcrum_SOW_v3.pdf

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
